resources.string:
Option A - ADB (from a computer):

1. Enable Developer options and USB debugging on this phone.
2. Connect the phone to a computer and install platform-tools (adb).
3. Run:

adb shell pm grant {appId} android.permission.MODIFY_QUIET_MODE

4. Reopen this app - the status below should switch to "granted".

Option B - Shizuku (no computer needed after first setup):

1. Install Shizuku from the Play Store.
2. Start it via "Wireless debugging" (Android 11+, Developer options), no computer required.
3. Install a Shizuku permission helper, or use the Shizuku app itself to grant the requested permission to this app when prompted.
4. Reopen this app to confirm the status below updates to "granted"."
